hints.title: Pairwise Character Comparison
hints.text: Fix two distinct characters a and b present in s, and compute max frequency(a) - frequency(b) over all valid substrings.

hints.title: Kadane Variant with Minority Obligation
hints.text: Map character a to +1 and b to -1. Kadane algorithm finds the maximum subarray sum, but b must occur at least once.

hints.title: Tracking Minority Character Presence
hints.text: Maintain whether character b has been encountered in the current active segment, and consider previous segments that included b.

hints.title: Pairwise Kadane Dynamic Programming Implementation

complexity.notes: Alphabet size is bounded by 26 distinct lowercase letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(n^2) substrings and computing frequency counts takes O(26 * n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant extra variables per character pair.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles the case where the minority character is dropped by reset but can serve as the required occurrence.
